title: Fourth Andreotti government dissolved, Fifth Andreotti government formed.
text: The Andreotti IV Cabinet, led by Giulio Andreotti, was the 34th cabinet of the Italian Republic. The government obtained confidence on 16 March 1978 in the Chamber of Deputies with 545 votes in favor, 30 against and 3 abstentions, and in the Senate with 267 votes in favor and 5 against.

title: First Cossiga government formed (this Cabinet lasts until April 1980).
text: The Cossiga I Cabinet, led by Francesco Cossiga, was the 36th cabinet of the Italian Republic. Cossiga resigned on 19 March 1980 and was re-appointed to form a second government.

title: Tuscia University is founded.
text: University of Tuscia is a university located in the city of Viterbo, Italy. Founded in 1979, the University comprises 6 academic departments.

title: Milano Due residential neighborhood is completed.
text: Milano 2 is a residential centre in the Italian town of Segrate (Province of Milan). It was built as a new town by Edilnord, a company associated with Silvio Berlusconi in the 1970s.

title: “Una donna per amico” by Lucio Battisti
text: "Una donna per amico" is a song composed by Lucio Battisti and Mogol, and performed by Lucio Battisti. It was released as a single in October 1978, with "Nessun dolore" as B-side.

title: “Meteor Man”
text: Eternal Atake 2 is the fourth solo studio album by American rapper Lil Uzi Vert, released on November 1, 2024, through Generation Now and Atlantic Records. The album features a sole guest appearance from Big Time Rush, while its production was primarily handled by Cashmere Cat and Brandon Finessin, with support from Henney Major, Lil 88, MCVertt, Charlie Puth, WondaGurl, and several other producers.

title: “Too Much Heaven”
text: "Too Much Heaven" is a song by the Bee Gees, which was the band's contribution to the "Music for UNICEF" fund. They performed it at the Music for UNICEF Concert on 9 January 1979.

title: “Born to Be Alive”
text: "Born to Be Alive" is a song written by French singer Patrick Hernandez. It became a worldwide hit and reached number one on the U.S. Billboard National Disco Action chart in early 1979.

title: “Tragedy”
text: "Tragedy" is a song released by the Bee Gees, written by Barry, Robin & Maurice Gibb, and included on their fifteenth album, Spirits Having Flown. The single was released in February 1979 by RSO Records, reaching number one in several charts including the UK in February 1979 and repeating the feat the following month on the US Billboard Hot 100.

title: “Il Carrozzone”
text: "Il carrozzone" is a 1979 Italian song composed by Piero Pintucci (music) and Franca Evangelisti (lyrics) and performed by Renato Zero.

title: “Knock on Wood”
text: "Knock on Wood" is a song by Eddie Floyd and Steve Cropper released as a single by Floyd in 1966. The song was later covered by other artists, most notably Amii Stewart in 1979.

title: “Tu Sei l'Unica Donna Per Me”
text: "Tu sei l'unica donna per me" is a 1979 song written and performed by Alan Sorrenti.

title: “Soli”
text: "Soli" is a song by Italian singer Adriano Celentano from his eponymous 1979 album Soli. As many songs on that album, it was written by Toto Cutugno.
